stem: A large room is controlled from one central temperature/RH sensor, while crop symptoms cluster along one wall. What measurement plan best tests whether the control sensor is representative?
choices: Map comparable measurements across canopy locations and relevant times, including the symptomatic zone and reference areas, while documenting sensor placement and exposure.
Trust the central sensor because the controller uses it.
Move the central sensor to the symptomatic wall and discard the previous data.
Measure only near HVAC supply air because it changes fastest.
rationale: Spatial mapping is needed to detect gradients and determine whether a single control sensor represents actual canopy conditions across the room.
